name: Small Multiples
summary: A grid of mini line / area / bar charts — one panel per segment, region or series — on a shared or independent scale, with last-value labels and a linked crosshair.
summary_zh: 分面小多图：每个业务板块 / 地区 / 序列一个迷你折线、面积或柱状图，可共享或独立 y 轴，末值标签，十字准线跨面板联动。
description_zh: 当一张图里有 4 条以上的线互相缠绕时，把它们拆成按 facet 字段分面的小图更易读。数据为长表（x + y + facet），同一 facet 与 x 的多行会按 agg 汇总（如按地区汇总的板块收入）。共享 y 轴时可直接比较规模，独立 y 轴时比较各自的形态；每个面板标题显示期间涨跌幅，ghost 选项在每个面板中以淡灰线显示其他序列作为参照，baseline 可画出 100 等基准线。所有面板在一个 ECharts 实例中，悬停时十字准线联动。
best_for: Segment or region revenue trends side by side
Rebased share-price performance vs. indices (with ghost context)
Any 3–12 series that overlap in a single line chart
avoid_when: One or two series (use line or combo)
More than ~12 facets (panels become too small)
When the exact cross-series comparison at each point matters most (use a single line chart)

columns.desc: Panels per row (null = auto from the available width, rows balanced)

sharedY.desc: One y scale for every panel (compare levels) or independent scales (compare shapes)

highlight.desc: Facet value(s) drawn in accent2 (e.g. the target company)

ghost.desc: Draw every other facet as a faint context line in each panel

baseline.desc: Dashed horizontal reference, e.g. 100 for rebased prices

lastLabel.desc: Label the last value of each panel

showChange.desc: First → last % change in each panel header (green / red)

agg.desc: Aggregation of duplicate rows per facet and x: sum | avg | last

maxPanels.desc: Panel cap (also limited to what fits the block height); further facets are left out with a '+N more not shown' note, highlighted facets always kept

format.desc: Value format; defaults to the y field format

dateFormat.desc: Time-axis label format when x is a date field

interactions: Crosshair linked across every panel; tooltip lists all facets at that x
Click a panel's series to cross-filter on the facet
Layout recomputed on resize; animated updates on filter changes
